reason: I would download it because it is free and I do want more than my coffee routine, but I would not buy a ticket through a brand-new app in the first month. I would browse, maybe star a yoga session, and keep finding events on Instagram like I already do.
objection: Who else is actually on this? If I tap join on a book club and show up alone to five strangers, or the app is dead in three months, I wasted my evening and I felt stupid. My stories and WhatsApp groups already tell me what my actual friends are going to.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that people I know, or at least a lot of real girls my age, are already going to events on it, with honest reviews, so joining alone does not feel like a gamble.
